settings.title: Unique Silo Suites Near Zion National Park

settings.editor: Experience cozy, modern suites set on historic farmland in La Verkin, Utah.

settings.title: Contact us for special pricing and availability

settings.editor:
Our property sits on a historic dairy farm once run by the Church family, who poured their hearts into this land for generations. What was once a working farm filled with cows and open pastures has been thoughtfully re-imagined into a collection of unique, modern silos, blending our family’s love for heritage, design, and hospitality.

Every silo carries a piece of our story, inspired by the places and moments that shaped our lives here in Southern Utah.
